title: BPP hello result (DESIGN.md §14.1, §14.5): server version advertisement for negotiation
description: The Success.result payload for op hello. versions lists the server's supported protocol minor versions so implementations can negotiate the highest common minor (§14.1); surface names the one §14.5 surface this channel is bound to; endpoint_incarnation identifies the endpoint (the hello closure is endpoint/version only, §14.7). DESIGN.md §14 does not enumerate these result fields; they are the minimal design-derived set and freeze with the bundle registry.
